data.narrative:
Ghost Robotics is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $1.85M to date. The valuation analysis incorporates a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—8 private and 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS)—spanning the same sector and stage cohort. Key private comparables include UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the $1.85M in total capital raised as a proxy for current value, then applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next financing stage, yielding $4.6M. The Peer-Median method examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B at Seed), Singularity ($400M at Series A), and NODA AI ($125M at Series A)—producing a median valuation of $400M with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $4M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $202M. The wide dispersion reflects fundamental uncertainty in stage-appropriate valuation for an early-stage frontier-tech company in a high-variance sector. Stage-Progression yields a floor grounded in deployed capital, while Peer-Median is sensitive to the wide spread in comparable valuations. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to peers, addressable market traction, and customer acquisition trajectory.
